players.bio: Alexander Francis Neil (born 9 June 1981) is a Scottish professional football manager and former player who played as a midfielder. He is currently head coach of EFL Championship club Millwall. Neil began his professional career at Airdrieonians in 2000, playing half a season in the Scottish Football League First Division before moving to Barnsley.
Alfie Henry Doughty is an English professional footballer who plays as a full-back, wing-back or midfielder for EFL Championship club Millwall.

Benicio Baker-Boaitey is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Millwall. Baker-Boaitey, an England youth international, had spells in the youth academies of West Ham United and Porto before turning professional at Brighton & Hove Albion in July 2023.
Caleb Joaquin Taylor is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Millwall.

Camiel Neghli is a professional footballer who plays for EFL Championship club Millwall. Born in the Netherlands, he represents Algeria at youth level. Club career On 12 July 2023, Neghli signed a contract with Sparta Rotterdam for the term of three years with an optional fourth year.
Casper De Norre (born 7 February 1997) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays for Millwall in the EFL Championship, as a defensive midfielder or a right back.

Daniel Kelly (born 3 October 2005) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Millwall. Kelly attended St Leonards Primary School in Scotland and was described as "first caught the eye of Celtic playing above his age group for East Kilbride Caledonian Thistle's 2004 team".

Daniel Tanveer Batth (born 21 September 1990) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Millwall. He has additionally represented Colchester United, Sheffield United and Sheffield Wednesday on loan. He is of mixed English and Sikh Punjabi descent. He declared he wanted to represent India at international level in July 2017.
Derek Mazou-Sacko (born 6 October 2006) is a French professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL Championship club Millwall.

Elkan Baggott is a 23-year-old professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Millwall FC. Born in Thailand and raised in England, Baggott represents his mother's country of Indonesia, where he first learned to play football as a child.
Oluwafemi "Femi" Javier Azeez Beloso is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion.

Filip Marschall is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Millwall. He has represented England at U19 level. Marschall joined the Academy at Aston Villa from Cambridge City in 2018.

George Evans (born 13 December 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder, centre-back or right-back for EFL League One club Burton Albion. Evans joined Manchester City at the age of six.
George Evans (born 13 December 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder, centre-back or right-back for Braintree Town.

Jake Matthew Cooper (born 3 February 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays for Millwall, as a defender. Cooper attended The Forest School, Winnersh and joined the Royals Academy as a 14-year-old in 2009, going on to sign his first professional contract with the club in June 2013, on a contract going through to the end of the 2015–16 season.
Jenson Metcalfe (born 6 September 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Millwall.
Joel Coleman is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Millwall.
Jordi Martin Emmanuel Osei-Tutu (born 2 October 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back or winger for EFL Championship club Millwall.
Joshua Guy Coburn (born 6 December 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Millwall.
Kyrell Jeremiah Lisbie is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Millwall.
Lukas Bornhøft Jensen (born 18 March 1999) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Millwall.
Luke James Cundle (born 26 April 2002) is an English footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for EFL Championship club Millwall.

Lyndon John Dykes (born 7 October 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Millwall. Dykes previously played for Merrimac, Redlands United and Surfers Paradise Apollo in Australia, and for Queen of the South and Livingston in Scotland.

Mark Sykes is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Millwall. Born in Northern Ireland, he plays for the Republic of Ireland national team, having previously represented Northern Ireland at underage level.

Massimo Corey Luongo (born 25 September 1992) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a defensive midfielder for the Australia national team and EFL Championship side Millwall. Born in Sydney, Luongo played youth football for APIA Leichhardt Tigers before moving to England to play for Tottenham Hotspur, where he started his professional career.

Mathis Servais is a 21-year-old Belgian professional footballer who plays as a versatile progressive midfielder or winger for English EFL Championship club Millwall FC. Club career On 8 June 2023, Servais signed a three-year contract with Beveren. On 9 September 2025, Servais moved to Mechelen with a four-season contract.

Maxime Teremoana Crocombe (born 12 August 1993) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Millwall. He also represents the New Zealand national team.

Mihailo Ivanović (born 29 November 2004) is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for EFL Championship club Millwall. Club career Vojvodina At the end of March 2021, Ivanović signed his first professional contract with Vojvodina. On 22 May 2022, Ivanović made his first-team debut, replacing Veljko Simić in the 90th minute in a 0:2 away win against TSC Bačka Topola.
Romain Joy Kouakou Esse is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger or forward for EFL Championship club Millwall on loan from Crystal Palace.

Ryan Ian Leonard (born 24 May 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays for Millwall. A midfielder, he graduated through the Plymouth Argyle Academy to make his senior debut in March 2010, following which he spent time on loan at Weston-super-Mare of the League South and Tiverton Town of the Southern Football League.
Taïryk Arconte is a 22-year-old professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward or right winger for EFL Championship club Millwall and the Guadeloupe national team.

Tristan Crama (born 8 November 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as a central defender for EFL Championship club Millwall. Crama is a product of the Béziers academy and transferred to Brentford in 2020.
Yanis Ali Issoufou is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship side Millwall. He represented both Niger and France internationally as a junior.
Zak Norton Sturge (born 15 June 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Millwall.
Zakariya Shakeel Lovelace is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Millwall.
